note.zh-TW: 分子用銷貨成本還是本期進貨，教材與模板不同（T27）。介面統一寫「帳」與「週轉率」，模板原字列為別名。
note.en: Whether the numerator is cost of sales or purchases differs between the slides and the template (T27). The interface uses one spelling and keeps the template wording as an alias.

definition.zh-TW: 一年內應付帳款被付清、再重新賒購幾次。次數越多表示付款越快，供應商給的賒帳期越短。
definition.en: How many times a year payables are settled and renewed through credit purchases. More turns mean faster payment and shorter credit from suppliers.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
